book.name: Maliku
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Maliku gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Ŋgaŋ kune muh wù gɛ̀ gɛlɛ bamii mwɛne
Jiso mo wu ja wu tu wu jɛme bo le a baŋgaŋ le lɛ,

content.text: “Muh mu gɛ̀ bee wu lɛŋ mwɛ wu muntaŋ mù ba fɛde mbvuuŋ yu, wu tuŋ kitaŋ ki kɛnɛ, wu fɛ kiso kì ba lé ba sôone muntaŋ fo mbvuuŋ bude, wu tuŋ kitale ki muh wu chiɛɛne mwɛ kwɛɛ, wu mo wu nya mwɛ kwɛɛ chiaaŋ yi bamii le, wu mo wu ja wu gɛɛŋ kituŋ kimi le.
Kife kì ba kege muntaŋ to ki kojɛ, wu tuŋ mwa lɛme fɛ bamii ba wù gɛ̀ nya mwɛ bo le lɛ wu fi mwe muntaŋ wu to bɛ mu.
Wu gɛɛŋ bo koo lo wu bo suŋ, bo kuŋ wu tu jiŋ chiaaŋ chiaaŋ.
Muh mwɛ kwɛɛ ka wu tuŋ mwa lɛme wumu, wu gɛɛŋ, bo ka bo suŋ wu bo chiɛɛ kikwɛɛ, bo choosɛ wu.
Wu ka wu tuŋ wumu, bo yuuyɛ wɛɛ. Wu ka wu tuŋ bamu wu mumwaa wu mumwaa bo duude lo, ba suŋ bamu, ba yuuyɛ bamu.
Wu gɛ̀ tuŋ bo, to shɛɛ wa gɛh muh wu mumwaa, muh wunɛ nyume mwa ye, wu le fitele fie. Wu mɛsɛ wu tuŋ wu fɛ bo le wu kwaji lɛ bo lé bo gɛ̂ɛŋ bo ŋgvuuŋ mwa ye wunɛ.
Geenɛ, bamii bayu jɛmɛ lɛbolɛbo lɛ, ‘Wunɛ le nji bvushɛ bvu muh wu mwɛ kfunɛ, bɛŋ to bee yuuyɛ wu bvushɛ bvuyu tu bwesa besabɛŋ.’
Bo mo bo koo wu, bo yuuyɛ, bo bvusɛ bo noŋ akfuuŋ a kitaŋ.”

content: No Jiso jɛmɛ nɛ, wu mo wu biih lɛ,

content.text: “Fiɛɛ fì taŋlo chiji kikwɛɛ wu mwɛ kfunɛ ge le la? Wu lé wu gê wu tô wu lɛɛshɛ lo bamii bayu, wu nya mwɛ kwɛɛ nyu wa bamii bamu le.
Bɛŋ gɛ̀ baaŋ a tɛɛŋ gɛ kijusɛ kinɛ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le gɛ? Ba le ba saŋ lɛ,
‘Tɛdɛ chiyu chiɛɛ chì bamii ba joone gɛ̀ faŋ, gɛ̀ ja chi kaasɛ chi tu tɛdɛ chi buu chi yeh.
Finɛ gɛ̀ ge Tada, bee jiiŋe bee kɛme ŋgha.’”

content: Bamii banɛ yu ŋgaŋ wunɛ, bo mo bo kɛɛ lɛ Jiso ma nyu bo le. Bo tu bo goone ki bo koo wu, bo faŋ kinchvu ki bamii ki gɛ̀ bee fo. Bo mo bo chinɛ wu le wu ja wu gɛɛne.
Ba telɛ Jiso kune ŋkolɛ ŋwa
Bikwɛɛ bi woŋ gɛ̀ ja bi tuŋ Bafalashii mo bamii bamu ba ŋgoo yi Nfoŋ Hɛlod le lɛ bo gɛɛŋ bo telɛ Jiso lɛ bo koo wu yi njɛmɛ we le.

Bo to, bo jɛmɛ Jiso le lɛ, “Muh wu N'yɛyɛ, bee kee lɛ wo to wo jɛme gɛh nyu nchiɛɛŋ, nje gɛ wo faane jise chi muh gɛ, kɛnɛ fiɛɛ fì le mwɛdɛ gɛ. Wo yɛyi nchiɛɛŋ nyu jɛ yi Nyo. Gɛh sɛɛŋ bee laa nchi le wu bɛɛŋ lɛ bee lâaŋe ŋwa Kaisa Nfoŋ wù Lum le, noo wu baaŋ bɛɛŋ gɛ le?
Bee lâaŋe, noo keefɛ be lâaŋe gɛ la?” Jiso kɛɛ fiɛɛ fì bo gɛ̀ wɛɛne bɛ fi, wu chvuu lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ tele mɛ nje la? Bɛŋ to bɛ danale n'yɛŋ.”

content: Bo to bɛ wu, wu fi, wu biih lɛ,

content.text: “Kikwɛɛ kinɛ kì le yu, le ki yɛɛŋ lɛ, jee chinɛ le chi yɛɛŋ lɛ?”

content: Bo chvuu lɛ, “Le ki Kaisa lɛ, jee le gɛh tɛ che.”
Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ nyâa fiɛɛ fì le fi Kaisa wu le, bɛŋ nyâa fi Nyo Nyo le.”

content: Bo yu noo, jwe yuŋ lo bo kune wu.
Ba telɛ Jiso kune kintaashɛ ki kwɛse bɛ jwɛŋsɛ sege bo bu yi kwe le
Basadushii bamu gɛ̀ ja bo to ki bo biih fiɛɛ Jiso le. Basadushii gɛ̀ bee bamii ba gɛ̀ duu lɛ gɛ bamii nyu bo ge bo bu yi kwe le gɛ.
No bo to, bo biih wu le lɛ, “Muh wu N'yɛyɛ, Musɛ gɛ̀ saŋ a banchi besa le lɛ,

content.text: ‘Nɛ muh jo kwɛse wu kwe mwa sɛŋ, tu mwa bwee kɛme ki wu gɛ̂ɛ kwɛse wuyu bɛ wu boo booŋ a jee chi ŋkfu mwa bwee le.’

content: Noo, muh mu gɛ̀ kɛme booŋ ba bilɛŋsɛ bvusooshwi, wù ŋgamu gɛ̀ jo kwɛse, wu kwe mwa sɛŋ.
Wù bii wu le, gɛɛ kwɛse wuyu, wu kwe tɛ mwa sɛŋ. Fi gɛ̀ kooshɛ gɛh tɛ yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ bɛ wù gɛ bii wuwɛɛ le.
Bo gɛ̀ gɛɛ wu bachii, muh gɛ̀ baaŋ nyu gɛ yu antɛnɛɛ a bamii ba bvusooshwi wù boo mwa bɛ kwɛse wɛɛ gɛ. Ajiŋ ayu kwɛse wɛɛ kwe tɛ.
No bamii ba bvusooshwi bayu gɛ̀ jo kwɛse wɛɛ bachii, sege bamii bude yi kwe le, wu le wù nyu kwɛ yɛɛŋ?”
Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ jɛme nɛ bɛŋ jiaade lo nje gɛ bɛŋ kee fiɛɛ fì ba saŋ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le gɛ, gɛ bɛŋ kee tɛ bvuŋga bvu Nyo gɛ?

Fiɛɛ fì le, le lɛ lé gê nyu sege bamii bude yi kwe le, gɛ bilɛŋsɛ bɛ bikɛse baaŋ bo ka bo taashi bvuguu gɛ, bamii baaŋ gɛ bo ka bo nyaa booŋ bo taashi bvuguu gɛ. Bo lé bo tô bo nyume wa njɛ banchɛndaa ba Nyo fɛwe.
Fiɛɛ fì kune no bamii lé bo gê bo bude yi kwe le, bɛŋ gɛ̀ baaŋ a tɛɛŋ gɛ kijusɛ a Ŋwa wu Musɛ le kune kite ki mbiaŋ kì wu gɛ̀ yɛŋ ki bɛde, Nyo jɛmɛ Musɛ le, wu duu lɛ,
‘Le mɛ wù Nyo wu Ablaham bɛ Nyo wu Asik mo Nyo wu Yakob?’
Wu lɛ gɛ Nyo nyume Nyo wu baŋkfu gɛ, le Nyo wu bamii ba baaŋ yu. Bɛŋ le bɛŋ jiaa baaŋ.”

content: Nchi wù fede banchi bachii

Muh mu wù gɛ̀ duunyi banchi ba Nyo gɛ̀ ja wu to, wu doo wu yu no Jiso bɛ bamii baa tɛɛnyi kintɛɛnyɛ, wu ka wu yɛŋ no wu chvuu fiɛɛ fì bo biide wu le a je yì joŋe le, wu mo wu biih tɛ Jiso le lɛ, “Nchi wù fede banchi bachii le wù la?”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Nchi wù fede banchi bachii le wunɛ wu duu lɛ,
‘O bamii ba Ishwala bɛŋ yû,
Tada Nyo, wù Nyo wese besabɛŋ,
Tada Nyo wuyu le gɛh wu mumwaa.
Wo kôŋe Tada Nyo wo bɛ fitele fiuŋ fichii, wo nya kikwɛɛ kuŋ wu le kichii, wo gɛ̂ɛde bvufee bwuŋ ye ye le bvuchii, wo lɛ̂ne fɛ wu le bɛ bvuŋga bwuŋ bvuchii.’
Nchi wù bii wunɛ le le lɛ, ‘Wo kôŋe muh wù le mbebe yo le no wo koŋe kikwɛɛ kuŋ.’
Gɛ nchi wumu ka nyu yu wù fede banɛ gɛ.”

content: Muh wù gɛ̀ duunyi banchi ba Nyo wɛɛ jɛmɛ Jiso le lɛ, “Muh N'yɛyɛ, wo le wo chvuu chuule. Wo jɛme nyu nchiɛɛŋ lɛ Nyo le gɛh wu mumwaa gɛ wumu ka nyume yu wù fede wu gɛ.

Ki wo kôŋe wu bɛ fitele fichii, wo gɛ̂ɛde bvufee ye ye le bvuchii, wo lɛ̂ne fɛ wu le bɛ bvuŋga bvuchii, bɛ kì wo kôŋe muh wu le mbebe yo le no wo koŋe kikwɛɛ kuŋ, fi fede lo ki ba gee bintanyɛ bɛ nyáŋ yì tonɛ mo bintanyɛ bimi.”
Jiso doo wu yɛŋ no wu chvuu njɛ muh bvufee, wu mo wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ wo nyu je yì ndefe le ki wo lêe bvunfoŋ bvù Nyo le gɛ.”

content: Ajiŋ ayu, muh gɛ̀ baaŋ ka moŋ gɛ, ki wu tô wu biih fiɛɛ wu le gɛ.
Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka le mwa yɛɛŋ
Jiso tu wu yɛyi bamii fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le, wu gɛ̀ ja wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bamii ba duunyi banchi jiɛnyi nɛɛ fɛ bo tu bo duu lɛ Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka le mwa Nfoŋ Dabi le?
Kiyo ki Yuude gɛ̀ ge wa Nfoŋ Dabi wunɛ jɛmɛ kune Mbvusɛ wuyu wu duu lɛ,
Tada Nyo gɛ̀ jɛmɛ Tada waŋ le lɛ, ‘Wu shii a kibo ke kinchiɛɛŋ le, gɛɛŋ bu sege wu lé wu gê wu giiŋsɛ bamii be ba kimbanɛ wu tomɛ bikaa bie yi bo le.’
Nɛ Dabi kibɛɛ tɛŋe wu lɛ Tada we, fi ka fì jiɛnyɛ nɛɛ fɛ wu tu wù nyu mwa ye?”

content: No Jiso jɛme mwɛɛ munɛ nɛ, kinchvu ki bamii kì gɛ̀ bee fo, tu ki yege, njoŋ yuu lo bo.
Jiso choojɛ gee chi bamii ba duunyi banchi ba Nyo
Wu doo wu yɛyi bamii wu ja wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ yɛ̂ne kune bamii ba duunyi banchi ba Nyo. Bo koŋe ki bo nooŋ nyu bikuŋ bì ndefe bo jiɛnyi bɛ bi manjuu ma ba kame chiwaaŋ fo lɛ bamii yɛ̂ɛse bo le bɛ ŋgvunɛ.
Bo koŋe ki bo shiide nyu fwe yéh yi buunɛ le. Sege bo le bo gɛɛŋ fɛ ŋka le, bo shiide nyu binta bì baaŋ baaŋ le.
Bo shiishi bakwɛŋkfu bo lɛɛde bɛ bo, bo fii yéh bɛ mwɛɛ muboo, bo buuse bo bɛ chibuunɛ chì ndefe. Wuboo ŋgɛ lé wu gê wu ya lo.”

content: Nnya yi kwɛŋkfu
Jiso ja wu gɛɛŋ wu shii kimbe kege le fɛ ŋku wu nnya le fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le, wu jiiŋe no bamii too bo gɛɛde bige a ŋku wuyu le. Bamii ba kwa ba duude tu bo too bo gɛɛde bige yo wesee.
Kwɛŋkfu wumu gɛ̀ ja wu to nyu muh wu kifufe, wu gɛɛ munini yo munfɛɛ mù le jise chi bige chi le gɛ fiɛɛ gɛ.
Jiso bɛɛŋ booŋ be ba ŋgoo wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ kwɛŋkfu wunɛ wu le muh kifufe nɛ, le wu nya wu fe bamii bachii ba gɛɛde fiɛɛ a ŋku wu yeh yi kintanyɛ le.

Bamii bachii ba be nyaa, be too nyu bɛ bimbɛge bi bvukugɛ bvuboo bvù le bvu yisɛ wa bvu tu bvu fuushi kuu. Geenɛ kwɛse wunɛ wu le kifufe kifufe nɛ le wu nya fiɛɛ fichii fì wu gɛɛde kikwɛɛ yu, nyu fi fì wu bee ki wu chêe yi fi le.”
